title: The European Fabless Semiconductor Association was formally launched today in Brussels; Semiconductor veteran Paul de Bot named its first President
gist: The European Fabless Semiconductor Association launched in Brussels on November 4. Its founders are Axelera AI, Quside, Semidynamics, SiPearl and VSORA, former TSMC executive Paul de Bot is its first president, and SiPearl CEO Philippe Notton chairs the board. The founders note that Europe holds less than 1% of the global fabless market and plan to lobby, pool services such as EDA licensing, and use European AI-factory and sovereign-cloud procurement to win customers. The association aims for more than 50 members within three years.

insights.claim: The European Fabless Semiconductor Association launched in Brussels on November 4, founded by Axelera AI, Quside, Semidynamics, SiPearl and VSORA. Former TSMC executive Paul de Bot is its first president during the incubation phase, and SiPearl CEO Philippe Notton chairs the board.
insights.speaker: B
insights.so_what: It creates a coordinated lobbying bloc of European AI and HPC chip startups that could shape EU subsidy and procurement policy.

insights.claim: The European Fabless Semiconductor Association was announced at an ALLPROs event attended by European Commission Executive Vice-President Henna Virkkunen. It is being set up as an international nonprofit under Belgian law, with formation support from the Quside-coordinated Horizon Europe VOICES project.
